newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing share market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing share market report.

text.p: Dutch shares spent a low-volume day hovering range-bound in record territory, finishing 10.09 points or 1.12 percent up at a new record close of 907.19.
The AEX blue chip index opened 3.49 points higher at 900.59 and spent the entire session above the 900 points threshold first breached briefly on Thursday.
Dealers said that the index rise was mainly powered by demand from retail latecomers in the absence of any strong selling activity, with institutionals mainly sidelined.
Turnover, routinely slow on a Friday, was further depressed by the U.S. holiday and a lack of fresh macro-economic data.

Printer and copier maker Oce benefited from first-half profits at the upper end of analysts' forecasts, closing 7.40 guilders higher at 257.90. The stock earlier touched an all-time high of 261.00 guilders.
Index heavyweight ABN AMRO topped the volume charts, adding one guilder to 39.40 on market rumours market that the bank's first-half results, due on August 21, would be at least 30 percent higher.
Another big gainer was chemicals group DSM, whose fine chemicals acquisition in India was well-received. The shares added 5.50 guilders to 205.00.
Dealers said that market sentiment remained positive, shrugging off a report from JP Morgan that both Dutch and Belgian markets were overbought.
"The current rise, especially for the Dutch market, is unfounded... it does not reflect prospective 1997 price/earnings," JP Morgan said.
Amsterdam dealers agreed, but said retail customers were unperturbed. "Share prices have already risen way beyond what the companies can deliver, but people keep buying," one said.
Another said latecomers were jumping in as the rally showed no signs of abating, seizing on any stock which made the news.
"Take Van Ommeren -- that's up 3.60 guilders because an investor magazine said the shares were cheap," he said.
On the local market, shares in car dealer Athlon Group mushroomed 24.30 guilders to 168.00 on a broker upgrade to "buy".
"Who knows where it will end?" another dealer said. "If we carry on like this the index will hit 1000 points in just over a month's time."
